node.statement: Transverse-moment budget (only O(tau) available). Under the hypotheses ||D||_1 = tau, negative mass ≤ t on every row, and the confinement that every nonactor support fiber Q lies in conv{p_v,p_w,p_f,p_z,p_o} or in the slab 0 ≤ y_Q ≤ 1, the attainable D-direction moment sum_j P_{ij}·x_j of any admissible row is bounded by an explicit absolute constant times tau: sum_j P_{ij}·x_j ≤ C·tau. This is the exact Farkas/dual certificate assembled from the mass-one constraint, the collinearity and coordinates of the actors (previous steps), the actor-hull vertices (each with x ≤ 1 attainable only at z, which the idempotence duality forbids the row from concentrating on), and the aggregated exterior sign-union negative-mass budget; each contributes O(tau) because ||D||_1 = tau ties every unit of transverse displacement to O(tau) of ℓ¹-length while the negative mass is capped at t = tau^2.
